verdict.rationale: Manufact documents a publish checklist that audits servers for "protocol compliance and platform readiness", plus a readiness scan for any MCP URL with public catalog scores. These are quality and readiness checks, not security scanning for malicious or vulnerable behavior, so they are an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story. Nothing in the pack describes vulnerability, malware, or tool-poisoning inspection of listed servers.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
